description: This Java class is a Spring configuration file setting up a batch job for applying charges to overdue loan installments within the Apache Fineract project. It defines beans for the job, its steps, and the associated tasklet, wiring necessary services.

classes.name: ApplyChargeToOverdueLoanInstallmentConfig
classes.description: Spring configuration class that defines beans for the batch job handling charges application to overdue loan installments.

methods.name: applyChargeToOverdueLoanInstallmentStep
methods.description: Defines the step in the batch job which executes the tasklet responsible for applying charges to overdue loan installments.

methods.name: applyChargeToOverdueLoanInstallmentsJob
methods.description: Defines the batch job that sequences the step and configures its execution parameters.

methods.name: applyChargeToOverdueLoanInstallmentTasklet
methods.description: Creates the tasklet bean that encapsulates the logic for applying charges to overdue installments.
